sentence: The reads are on provider.auth (ProviderAuth) and model (Model), neither of which is ModelAuth.
The max and min reads are Math.max and Math.min calls, not RangeProps fields.
Only options.args comes from the launch options copy, while timeout is a key in an object literal passed to Deferred.create next to the mocha this.timeout() call.
The tools and resources names appear as keys written in an object literal and in a parsed JSON config, never read from a ServerCapabilities value.
The reads are params.context on the grep tool parameters and the Object.entries call, not a BoundaryState value.
The size and fps reads are on the video fixture option and dispose is called on an APIRequestContext, not a ScreencastClient.
The reads are on contextOptions, which is the public BrowserContextOptions type, not the channels BrowserNewContextParams.
The elements and appState reads are on data, which is explicitly typed ImportedDataState, not ExportedDataState.
The reads are on this._liveTraceFile (a local object type) and this._options (TraceOptions), not a StackSession.
The receiver requests[n].failed.message is typed AssistantMessage through ModelRouteRequest.failed.message, and the test reads its errorMessage and stopReason.
The cost and input reads are on the local options parameter of the assistant helper, not a FauxModelDefinition.
Only options.apiKey is read from the SimpleStreamOptions parameter, and headers is read from the locally cast fetch response data.
The cleanup call is on a test Harness and signal is read from the getAuth overrides argument, not a CombinedAbortSignal.
The channel and proxy matches are inside JSDoc comment text in a declaration file, not field reads.
The reads are on imageAuth.auth (ModelAuth from AuthResult), a Model returned by getModel, and the generateImages options, not a Provider.
The reads are on contextOptions (public BrowserContextOptions), and _newContextForReuse is called with no options, so no BrowserNewContextForReuseOptions value is read.
The x and y reads are on pointerDownState.origin, typed as an inline x and y object in PointerDownState, not RectangleBox.
Only setResponses is called on setup.faux, while the state reads are on durable task objects.
The reads are on props of the local Props type, whose elements and appState are NonDeletedExcalidrawElement[] and UIAppState.
The reads are a model field on a tool result entry and faux.provider on the faux handle, not a ClassifierResult.
The method and params reads are on an IPC message typed any, not a CDPSessionSendParams.
The reads are stream.closed on an AgentEventStream and usage.input on a message usage, not a GrammarToolInputJsonBuffer.
The reads are on message, which is typed AssistantMessage, not AssistantImages.
The viewport reads are on frame, a local AnnotateFrame whose data comes from the dashboard channel screenshot result, not a PageScreencastFrameEvent.
The reads are browser.process() on the Browser and connection on a BidiBrowser instance, not a BidiBrowserOptions value.
The reads are on stats from getSessionStats and on a Model from getModel, not a FauxModelDefinition.
The receiver crop is element.crop of a narrowed ExcalidrawImageElement, typed ImageCrop, and the code reads its x, y, width, height, naturalWidth and naturalHeight.
The x and y reads are on match.element, a text element, and SearchMenu never obtains a RenderPositionOffset.
The input and output reads are on a durable UsageDoc models entry, not the AiGatewayPricing script type.
The toolsAdded and toolsRemoved reads are on a narrowed SystemMessage, which declares those fields itself rather than using ToolStateChanges.
